# De Gruyter Brill

> De Gruyter Brill is a leading academic publisher offering peer-reviewed open access and hybrid journals across education, agriculture, linguistics, materials science, law, and regional studies.

De Gruyter Brill publishes high-impact international journals with a strong commitment to open access models including Subscribe-to-Open and gold open access. The publisher serves diverse academic communities with publications in multiple languages, particularly German, and maintains comprehensive journal archives with indexing in major scholarly databases.

## Key Topics

- peer-reviewed journals
- open access publishing
- Subscribe-to-Open model
- gold open access
- Creative Commons licensing
- article processing charges
- journal archives
- academic databases
- multidisciplinary research
- German-language publications
- materials science
- education research
- linguistics and lexicography
- law and economics
- regional studies

## Flagship Open Access Journals

- [Open Education Studies](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/edu/html): International peer-reviewed open access journal publishing education research across all levels and teaching modalities.
- [Open Agriculture](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/opag/html): Open access journal covering agriculture, sustainable development, and UN sustainable development goals.
- [Zeitschrift für Kristallographie - Crystalline Materials](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/zkri/html): Historic crystallography journal founded 1877, transitioning to gold open access for crystal structures.
- [Scandinavian Journal of Pain](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/sjpain/html): Open access journal on pain research and management, official organ of Scandinavian pain association.
- [Comparative Southeast European Studies](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/soeu/html): Open access quarterly multidisciplinary journal on Southeast European politics, society, and comparative studies.
- [Digital Studies in Language and Literature](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/dsll/html): Peer-reviewed open access journal on digital technology, computational linguistics, and digital humanities.

## Subscribe-to-Open Transition Journals

- [Review of Law & Economics](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/rle/html): Peer-reviewed journal on law and economics transitioning to open access via Subscribe-to-Open model.
- [Probus - International Journal of Romance Linguistics](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/prbs/html): Double-blind peer-reviewed journal on Romance linguistics transitioning to gold open access.
- [Journal of African Languages and Linguistics](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/jall/html): Peer-reviewed journal on African linguistics transitioning to gold open access via Subscribe-to-Open.

## Humanities and Cultural Studies

- [Paragrana](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/para/html): International transdisciplinary journal on historical anthropology and Slavic studies from Freie Universität Berlin.
- [Zeitschrift für Kultur- und Kollektivwissenschaft](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/zkkw/html): German-language peer-reviewed journal on cultural studies and collective science with complete archive access.
- [Jahrbuch der Juristischen Zeitgeschichte](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/jjzg-b/html): German-language annual publication on legal history with open access and hybrid publishing model.
- [Lexicographica](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/lexi/html): International peer-reviewed annual yearbook on lexicography, dictionary-making, and computational lexicography.

## Materials Science and Technology

- [HTM Journal of Heat Treatment and Materials](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/htm/html): Bilingual peer-reviewed journal on heat treatment and materials technology with complete archive access.

## Archived and Ceased Publications

- [Journal of international biotechnology law](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/jibl/html): Ceased publication journal on international biotechnology law (2004-2009).
- [Electrochemical Energy Technology](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/eetech/html): Closed open access journal on electrochemical energy storage, batteries, and fuel cells archived in Portico.
- [Zeitschrift für Miet- und Raumrecht](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/zmr/html): German-language legal journal on rental and lease law with ceased publication status.
- [Nanospectroscopy](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/nansp/html): Ceased open access journal on nanospectroscopy, nanotechnology, and physics-chemistry topics.
- [Fractional Calculus and Applied Analysis](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/fca/html): Ceased publication mathematics journal on fractional calculus and applied analysis.
